en: GS - A messenger has arrived from Thunderdoom. They say Imperial magic armor and troops have begun gathering at the Imperial base in Cyrups.

Draupnir - They've moved faster than I expected. We lost most of our best troops in Trisys; if Thunderdoom falls, we'll surely be pushed back through Astania all the way to Dagal. Now it seems there's only one thing we can do...
Gishne - Break the seal on the Citadel of the Sky, after all...
GS - So you've solved the secret of the Three Treasures.

Gishne - Mostly, I think. If you lay the patterns of the sword and the scepter over the pattern of the crown, they show the direction of the sealed place. It seems to lie far across the sea. The rest, I think, we can only learn once we get there.

Draupnir - Either way, right now the only way to stand against the Imperial invasion is with the help of the Twelve Gods. GS, I will knight every member of your mercenary band as knights of Pandragon. You are Pandragon's last hope. The knights of Pandragon were once called the Holy Knights, but since you began as mercenaries, we'll call you the 'Irregular Knights'. Please save Pandragon from this peril.
GS - But will breaking the seal of the Twelve Gods really change anything? And there's no guarantee we'll succeed, is there? Still, I'll do my best.
Draupnir - I've arranged a ship to the sealed place, sailing from the port of Dakama. For Pandragon and for Silver Arrow, I pray you succeed.
